decisions.reason: The source establishes a row-extension workflow for the Board Meeting table; it does not change paragraph line-break or hard-return behavior in text-entry contexts.
The row-insertion and field-copying workflow does not change which theme colors are available.
The source does not discuss or alter bullet appearance, sizing, alignment, spacing, or level variants.
The source prescribes how to extend a structured Board Meeting row, not how designated interactive text fields accept multiple lines.
Copying fields into an inserted row does not change the requirement that placeholder text clear when an interactive field is activated.
The source concerns Board Meeting row creation and does not modify fixed margins or clipping prevention in Vejledning.
The instruction to copy fields within a newly inserted Board Meeting row is distinct from copying content from legacy templates into new templates.
Although both concern tables, the source defines a row-extension workflow and does not change the requirement that pasted tables and columns remain within page bounds.
The source does not alter Tab-controlled list levels or nested-list alignment.
Copying existing fields into an inserted row does not change the required style set or its coverage across templates.
The Board Meeting editing workflow does not modify the task-local assessment process or required assessment outputs.
The source does not change the required spacing between entered text and the line on the right.
